label: Gifts on Quantity
purpose: Show free gift products that unlock at certain cart-quantity thresholds of the main product
_notes:
Up to 4 gift slots (gift_1..gift_4). Leave gift_N (product picker) empty — you have no real product handle to reference; the merchant assigns the actual gift product later (it must be a unique product, not used elsewhere, tagged 'collection-hidden' and 'search-hidden'). gift_N_quantity is the minimum quantity of the MAIN product required to unlock that gift (defaults 1/2/3/4 — keep ascending). gift_N_badge_text is inline_richtext and supports the [compare_price] placeholder. gift_N_top_text / gift_N_bottom_text are short inline_richtext labels shown on the LOCKED gift tile (defaults are like '2 PACK' / 'Exclusive'). inline_richtext fields must NOT be wrapped in

tags, but inline tags like are fine. Excluded as pure visual: border_thickness/style, corner_radius, locked_background, locked_image_opacity/blur, unlocked_bg_color/border_color, gift_box_animation/color/tie_color, badge_style/width/radius/bg_color/text_color, locked_badge_colors/bg_color/text_color, gift_N_cross_out_compare, gift_N_compare_price_based_on, margins.
